generation_executor: render_candidates.py in this directory — PARAMETRIC ON THE BRIEF (frame 72x72mm PRIOR-tier web measurement; nothing hard-codes a millimetre) with colour/typeface constants from their recorded brand authority (substrate treatment colours, SET_FACE). All geometry computed from scratch; deterministic (B3's stipple uses a fixed seed — re-runs are byte-stable). Two-ink discipline: 'tint' readings achieved by hairline weight and dot density, never a third colour.
es3083_distinction: None of the five ES3083 directions is recycled (rose gesture, twelve-rosette, monumental letterform, inverted-ground sprig, corner wordmark). B4, the required quiet_minimal, is symmetric-centered and frameless — the opposite composition of ES3083 A5's asymmetric corner patch. B5's seal is plain-circle at ~13mm device scale, a different genre and scale from A2's lid-filling interleaved rosette.
vendor_styling_not_carried: The vendor sheet's Super Stay lockup, COOL! badges, 24H wear claim, and pink colourway are absent by rule. Words are the established set BBROSE / FACE POWDER / POLVOS only.
first_render_defects_caught: Visual verification of the first contact sheet caught B2's mesh math: wrong line-endpoint clamping produced converging fan wedges with a dark corner clump instead of a uniform 45-degree mesh. Rewritten as the two correctly-clipped line families x-y=c and x+y=c and re-verified by eye. The other four candidates and assert_text_fits passed first render.

candidates.title: POWDER-BOX GARLAND — heritage perimeter leaf garland on a hairline frame, centered stack
candidates.originality_statement: Takes the vintage powder-box GENRE convention (perimeter garland frame, centered modest words — e01) and the ornament-as-quiet-field discipline (e08/e12). The garland is an original repeating leaf unit drawn parametrically; no vintage box's artwork traced or closely derived.

candidates.title: VEIL MESH — all-over hairline 45° mesh reading as fabric over skin, calm clearing for the words
candidates.originality_statement: Takes the abstract veil/scrim texture idea (e03), whole-field micro-grain evenness (e16), and drifting-hairline calm (e21). The mesh is constructed geometrically from scratch at 0.06mm hairline weight — no wallpaper or photo texture sampled; the 'tint' is weight, not a third colour.

candidates.title: PUFF BLOOM — the ghost of a powder puff pressed once; tone from dot density alone
candidates.originality_statement: Takes the density-gradient stipple idea (e17), the off-centre pressed-once bloom (e19), and tone-from-density dissolution (e24). The stipple is a deterministic seeded jittered-grid sampling with radial falloff computed in-script — no halftone asset or generator output copied.

candidates.title: QUIET PLATE — dead-centre micro-stack, equal margins, ground as hero
candidates.originality_statement: Takes ground-as-hero colour economy (e04), spaced-caps hierarchy-by-tracking (e05/e27), and the center-weighted brand plate (e07). Recorded owner taste honoured; composed symmetric and frameless — distinct from ES3083 A5's corner patch. Nothing copied; set fresh in Crimson Text.

candidates.title: PHARMACY SEAL — small dotted-ring B seal, one hairline rule, formal three-line stack
candidates.originality_statement: Takes the seal-scale device idea (e15/e22), the hairline-rule pharmacy formality (e25), and type-as-ornament stacking (e13). The seal is original plain-circle geometry with the brand's own initial; not the A2 rosette class, and no apothecary label or brand seal reproduced.
